title: Builder API Routes
description: Complete builder-facing API with authentication, project management, units CRUD, media upload, lead management, appointment handling, and dashboard statistics. All endpoints integrated with permission engine for role-based access control.
features: Authentication: Login OTP generation and verification
Project Management: Create, list, get, update projects
Project Status: Activate and pause projects
Units Management: Add, update, delete units within projects
Media Upload: Upload photos/videos for projects
Lead Management: List leads, get lead details, update lead status
Appointment Handling: List appointments, update appointment status
Dashboard Statistics: Total projects, active/paused projects, total units, sold/available units, total leads, total appointments, revenue metrics
Permission-based access control using permission engine
Builder-specific data filtering (only see own projects/leads)
result_summary: Complete builder API with 20+ endpoints covering authentication, project/unit management, media upload, lead/appointment handling, and dashboard analytics. Full permission engine integration ensures builders only access their own data. Production-ready for builder portal frontend.
